s: The Grok 3 'Copy Text' feature, when accessed via X.com, incorrectly strips all Markdown formatting (headers, lists, bold, italics, inline code, code fences), rendering it unusable for workflows like Jekyll SSG. The issue was later resolved by accessing Grok directly via grok.com, which handles Markdown copying correctly.
